_comment: Preconfigured instances of the Cat-2 prop-table <people-groups-grid>. provider:'maplibre' flags each generated standalone page as TOKEN-FREE (no Mapbox token ladder) since this grid is a fetch-driven list, not a map. Each instance is one preset of the element's props: 'standalone' owns its own search + 4 dropdowns; 'driven' turns its own controls off (show-search/show-filters=false) to be driven by a parent header via props/events.
